title: Flagged player kills
subtitle: Players whose in-game UID played for a team they are not on. Choose whose kills count toward the team score.
countAllHintOn: On: every flagged player's kills are included in their team's total. Turn it off to drop them all, then allow specific players below.
countAllHintOff: Off: flagged players' kills are dropped from team totals. Use the list below to let specific players count.
noFlags: No flagged players in this event.
noFlagsHint: When an uploaded match-log file includes a UID that is not on the team's roster, that player appears here.
